tips.text: Hit the daily standing cap with high-affinity content first, then turn in banked medallions, which do not count against the cap.
Fill the cap fastest with Elite Sanctuary Onslaught (leave at round 8), the Duviri Circuit from stage 4, or Draco Interception.
Collect medallions from every Syndicate Alert and redeem them in bulk; they never expire.
Take the Archwing part as your rank 3 gift to skip its 20,000 standing purchase.
Rank Steel Meridian and Red Veil together, one syndicate pledged at a time, and New Loka last.
Hold the rank's item before you rank up; the rank-up spends all your standing at that rank plus credits and the item.
Nobody finds Agkuza hard, only slow from the daily cap; most players already have all three syndicates ranked.
